title: alchemilla hoppeana subsp. glacialis
intro: Alchemilla hoppeana subsp. glacialis, commonly known as Glacier Lady's Mantle, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. It is known for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Alchemilla hoppeana subsp. glacialis include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe and heal wounds, reduce pain and inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities.
